Juvenile culpability

Roper v. Simmons (2005) - banned juvenile execution
Graham v. Florida (2010) - banned life without parole for juveniles in non-homicide cases
Miller v. Alabama (2012) - extended Graham to homicide cases: banned mandatory life without parole for juveniles, even in homicide cases
Montgomery v. Louisiana (2016) - made Miller retroactive, so those sentenced prior to Miller could seek resentencing
